## Objective
- “텍스트게임. 라이자챗ai 처럼 여행을 하고 싶어. 장르는 발더스게이트처럼 사냥 채집 제작이 되어야하 거 캐릭터생성을 할수있어야해 성별 종족 스텟 초기 마스터리 등. 마스터리 시스템으로 장비숙련시 기술해금, 마법숙련시 기술해금, 채집방식별 숙련시 기술해금이 되어야해”
- Build a complete, playable Korean fantasy travel RPG in the current project.

## Requirements
- Character creation must include gender, race, stats, and starting mastery.
- Travel gameplay should support hunting, gathering, and crafting.
- Mastery growth should unlock skills for equipment, magic, and gathering disciplines.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone responsive browser game in one `index.html`, with Korean text, localStorage saves, turn-based combat, three travel regions, and six mastery paths.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created character creation for gender, six races, stats, and six starting masteries.
- Implemented exploration, region travel, hunting combat, herbal gathering, mining, rest, recipes, inventory, XP/levels, mastery progression and skill unlocks.
- Added save/resume via localStorage and reset journey control.
- `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js` passed.
- Browser smoke-tested character creation, gathering, and combat victory.

### Active
- Finish any final verification and report the completed game to the user.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect current `index.html` for any final fixes and run a fresh browser check if useful.
2. Summarize implementation and mention reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Entire game implementation and styling.

- A browser smoke test on `http://localhost:3002` confirmed character creation and gathering work; combat ended in victory as expected.
- Playwright initially reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404); an inline data favicon was added afterward, but no follow-up browser check was performed.
